website_metadata.notes: VTB Bank (PJSC) India operates a single New Delhi branch focused on corporate/business/forex banking for two-way Russia/CIS-India trade (term loans, trade finance, guarantees). The official site vtb.bank.in lists corporate, business and forex banking only; no retail deposit products or FD interest-rate table are published. Foreign wholesale bank with no retail FD.

warnings: Aggregator sites (codeforbanks) claim generic FD features but show no real published rate table; not used as a source.
